Some topics live in the `a2acli` **repository** rather than on this site — either
because they are explicitly out of scope here (comparison, release process,
build/design internals) or because the repository holds the canonical source.
This page maps those topics to their locations. These are GitHub blob links, so
they resolve independently of this documentation site.

## Canonical references

- **[Reference Manual (`docs/MANUAL.md`)](https://github.com/ghchinoy/a2acli/blob/main/docs/MANUAL.md)**
  — the full, canonical command reference: complete grammar, every flag,
  examples, output schemas, global flags, shell completion, and automation
  guidance. The [command reference](/a2acli/reference/command-model/) on this
  site is a curated, themed view of the same surface.
- **[A2A specification (a2a-protocol.org)](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/)** —
  the protocol itself, which `a2acli` implements.
